title: How are you finding and managing AI skills?
excerpt: How do you find skills, keep them organized, and make sure they actually work? Do you keep improving them over time?
content_html:
How do you find skills, keep them organized, and make sure they actually work? Do you keep improving them over time?

I believe skills will end up eating model capabilities, but until then I'm just looking for a better way to manage things.
